title: Pandolfi going to Los Alamos to talk to a live alien

tellings.quote: meets and he says, "Uh I'm going to Los Alamos uh this week. I'm gonna talk to I'm talking to Live Elliot."

plain: In 1991 a man named Ron Pandolfi is said to have told people he met that he was going to Los Alamos, the weapons laboratory in New Mexico, that week to talk to a live alien. A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron relays this to Michels, tying the story to Pandolfi's contacts Dan Smith and John B. Alexander. If true, it would mean a living non-human being was held at a US government lab.
